title: Refused unauthenticated requests create no server-side session: no JSESSIONID cookie on 401, logins still persist

criteria.given: an unauthenticated request to a protected /rest/** URL (anonymous, or with a padded header)
criteria.then: the 401 response sets no cookie carrying JSESSIONID (an XSRF-TOKEN cookie may still be written), so no HTTP session — and no persisted session file — is created for a request that was refused before login

criteria.given: a failed login (bad password at POST /rest/saiku/session, or wrong Basic credentials on a protected URL)
criteria.then: the 401 responses set no cookie carrying JSESSIONID, so a refused login leaves no 7-day session behind
the 200 response still sets JSESSIONID and the session endpoint answers, so saiku#1859's persisted logged-in session behaviour is unchanged
